test_item:
The KeyInstall feature shall adhere to Android 14 development and security standards, including:
(no SELinux denial is recorded while KeyInstall runs in enforcing mode)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. The DUT runs in SELinux enforcing mode
proc:
1. PENDING: X-f-2 KeyInstall designated task execution + trigger
2. Confirm the avc log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s avc
er:
1. PENDING: X-f-2 KeyInstall designated task execution + trigger
2. The adb logcat -s avc output contains no "avc: denied" entry related to KeyInstall
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
